sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection list I1, which must be carried out on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated 
by eng. Reda Mohamed Said Hendawy, tested by eng. Abdel Rahman Nassar at 02 
April 2005, accepted by eng. Mohamed Abdel Salam Mahmoud general directir, 
revised by EDEPC inspection & quality control eng. Abouda Elbana, approved by 
eng. Tarek Yousef Aly: head sector of Ayon Mousa PS..

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC

 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.

sections.text: احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the 
 circuit breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect 
 electric terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must 
 be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must 
 be completely drainage.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Pump in Service

Measure 
 vibrations level for bearings and compare it with the setting value, then 
 analyze it and determine what to do (if it is needed).

Check discharge quantity and pressure and 
 compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- out components 
 (if it is needed).

Pump Technical Specification:
Pump Name | Boiler Feed Pump (Turbine 
 Driven)
Pump Type | Mالمرحلة النهائية 
 مضخة من النوع البرميلي، مزودة بدفاعات شعاعية، ومدخل تدفق فردي
Delivery Quantity:
Rating, 
 min/max | 12200، 3333,18000 لتر في الدقيقة
ضغط | Pin = 18.5bar & Pout=209 bar
Speed | 1490 rpm
Weight of Pump | 6.0 Ton
Type of Recommended Oil | ISO-VG 46
Quantity of Oil Filling | Pressurized Oil Circulation 
 from the Turbine Oil Supply Unit
 (P=0.8-1.5 bar), (Q=7.0 L/min for radial bearing&65.0 L/min for axial 
 bearing)
Exchange Interval Oil | For Life (also according to 
 oil analysis )
